mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tw_h5_user WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM tw_h5_user WHERE phone = #{phone} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tw_h5_user(phone, password_hash, salt, balance, free_views_remaining, vip_level, vip_start_at, vip_expire_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{phone}, #{passwordHash}, #{salt}, #{balance}, #{freeViewsRemaining}, COALESCE(#{vipLevel}, 0), #{vipStartAt}, #{vipExpireAt}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE tw_h5_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, salt = #{salt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tw_h5_user SET balance = #{balance}, free_views_remaining = #{freeViewsRemaining}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tw_h5_user SET free_views_remaining = GREATEST(0, free_views_remaining + #{delta}), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tw_h5_user SET free_views_remaining = free_views_remaining - 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND free_views_remaining > 0
UPDATE tw_h5_user SET vip_level = #{vipLevel}, vip_start_at = #{vipStartAt}, vip_expire_at = #{vipExpireAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
